## Context

Critically evaluate six architecture recommendations derived from the audit at code snapshot 5fb693345b0cd1b48d1e9d20b292fd15761c7624. Assess both the historical snapshot and the current main/worktree so that already-landed changes or stale premises are not presented as current facts. This is a read-only research task; no production or documentation files will be changed.

## Plan

- Establish the audited snapshot, current HEAD, and repository/ADR context for each recommendation.
- Verify cited implementation claims, size/complexity claims, compatibility paths, and stated ADR intent from source, tests, history, and ticket evidence.
- Research the external dependency claims material to Burr, DSSE/in-toto, controller-runtime, git-bug, and Pluggy before judging those options.
- For each recommendation, separate factual accuracy, recommendation validity, future-code impact, stability/bug impact, and maintenance/confusion impact.
- Identify hidden migration costs, boundary risks, overclaims, and safer sequencing; give an evidence-weighted disposition rather than accepting hotspot counts as causation.
- Record findings and final conclusions on this ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Each of the six recommendations has a source-cited accuracy assessment against snapshot 5fb6933 and current code.
- [x] Each has an explicit disposition and qualitative confidence.
- [x] Forecasts cover future code shape, stability/bugs, maintenance burden, and confusion, including migration risk.
- [x] Historical commit heuristics are distinguished from causal defect evidence.
- [x] External-framework claims used in the evaluation are verified from primary sources.
- [x] The final synthesis prioritizes actions by expected net value and identifies prerequisites or ADR research needed.
